import zlib,struct
d=open('spec.png','rb').read()
p=8;idat=b''
while p<len(d):
    l,=struct.unpack('>I',d[p:p+4]);t=d[p+4:p+8];c=d[p+8:p+8+l];p+=12+l
    if t==b'IHDR':print(struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB',c))
    if t==b'IDAT':idat+=c
    if t==b'PLTE':print('plte',c)
raw=zlib.decompress(idat);print(len(raw))
open('/tmp/raw','wb').write(raw)
"
